itens.trecho: 'Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde' is almost watchable, but I'd say I was more bored than locked onto what I was watching across the 90 minutes. It feels like a partial retread of the first film, it does its own thing but this one hits very similar beats; gets a touch tedious.
Not as good as the first but still an ok movie. We get to see Elle Woods being an attorney more. She's pretty good at what she does.
